ambient_events: The bar fire ticks as it cools, then comes back on with a small thump.
Something in the yard settles, and a long way down the stack, something else answers.
The scales swing gently on their hook, weighing nothing, for no reason.
A page turns in the ledger. Nobody turned it.
description: A site shack on blocks, panelled in scrap and heated too hot by a bar fire. The counter is a scaffold board on two oil drums, worn pale where elbows land. Behind it, pigeonholes labelled in marker with part names and prices crossed out twice. A set of hanging scales. An open ledger. The window looks west over the yard. Out east to the gate.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that's more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Salvage Rites
